intelligence.human_view: Imagine you tell someone the same thing ten times — "use what already works, stop making new things" — and the eleventh time, they make something new again. That is not a lesson they learned; that is a lesson they heard. The difference is mechanical: a learned lesson changes what the next person can do, so the mistake becomes impossible, not just discouraged. Shawn's question — "Haven't you learned this lesson already?" — is the test the machine must ask itself after every correction. The cost of failing it is his patience, spent over and over on the same correction. The fix is proof before his eyes: the frames match, measured, before he sees the build again. And the loop's own standing rule: if he has to say it again, the compound did not run — say so plainly, and fix the loop.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine someone tells you the same thing over and over! And every time, you forget it and do it again! That is what happened here! Shawn said, "Stop making new things — use what already works!" But the next builder made something new again! So Shawn had to say it again! A lesson only counts when you change what you do, so he never has to say it again!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — imagine you tell someone the same thing over and over, dear — "use what already works, stop making new things" — and every time, they go and make something new again! That's not learning, love, that's just hearing! A lesson only counts when it changes what the next person does, dear — so the mistake can't happen again! And the proof is showing the frames match, love, measured and true, before he ever has to look again!
intelligence.naya_view: A lesson he repeats is a lesson not learned — filed, not lived. The test after every correction: will he have to say this again? The compound runs so the next builder CANNOT repeat the mistake: inventory + brief-template + Project Intelligence + GitHub, same pass. The fix round proves the frames match before his eyes — same frame as the agreement, fitted whole, no new design, measured not claimed. If he says it again, the compound did not run — record it plainly in the daily log and fix the loop. Proof standard: the next day shows the correction in the note, the Factory, the template, Project Intelligence, GitHub — and in the build that comes back.
